title: Past experimental interbreeding between aliens and humans

tellings.quote: >> I got the impression that they had interbreeded before um experimentally.

plain: Aliens and humans interbred in the past, as an experiment. That is the impression Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA hired him to talk with aliens, tells Michels he formed during that work in the early 1990s: "I got the impression that they had interbreeded before, um, experimentally." If true, some human ancestry would be the result of a deliberate experiment.
